summary: The proposed patch appears to be a minor improvement to the QuerySet.ordered property, but it lacks documentation and may have a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding a complex conditional statement without a clear explanation of its purpose.
The patch does not include any documentation or comment updates to explain the change or its implications.
The patch may benefit from a minor refactor to improve readability, but this is not a blocking issue.
